# Forge

> Forge is a PHPStorm-style IDE for Windows, Linux and macOS with a Rust + Tauri 2 backend and a SolidJS + CodeMirror 6 UI. Layout, wording, behaviour and the default keymap follow PHPStorm; language and framework support comes in packs: PHPForge (PHP, Laravel, Symfony, Doctrine), WebForge (HTML/CSS/JS/TS, Vue, React, Angular), LuaForge (Lua), PyForge (Python), JavaForge (Java with Maven and Gradle, Groovy, Scala, Android), GoForge (Go), RustForge (Rust) and KotlinForge (Kotlin/JVM). AI providers, Claude Code / Gemini CLI chat and AI commit messages are part of the core. Links below are relative to this file (docs/); docs/llms-full.txt has every guide page in one file.

Forge's rule of thumb is "Rust computes, TypeScript renders": logic lives in Rust crates (`crates/forge-*`, `packs/<pack>/<plugin>`), the UI only renders, and browser mode (`pnpm dev` in `app/ui`) runs the UI against mocks and the same Rust crates compiled to WebAssembly. Language servers are external and installed by the user.

## Getting started

- [Installation](guide/getting-started/installation.md): install Forge as an AppImage, deb or rpm on Linux, or an installer on Windows and macOS
- [First start](guide/getting-started/first-start.md): the Welcome screen and its recent projects list
- [Opening and creating projects](guide/getting-started/projects.md): open folders, recent projects, the New Project dialog and generators
- [Project detection](guide/getting-started/project-detection.md): how Forge detects frameworks and activates plugins
- [Coming from PHPStorm](guide/getting-started/from-phpstorm.md): what is the same, what differs and what is not there yet

## User guide

- [User guide overview](guide/user/index.md): all user topics
- [Workbench](guide/user/workbench.md): main window, main menu, tool windows, editor tabs and split editors, Recent Locations, Bookmarks, Find, TODO and Notifications tool windows, status bar
- [Windows, modes and layouts](guide/user/windows-and-layouts.md): several project windows, Presentation / Distraction-Free / Zen / Full Screen, Zoom IDE, tool window view modes (Float, Undock, Window), editor tabs in their own window, Window | Layouts
- [Markdown, images and CSV](guide/user/markdown-images-csv.md): Markdown editor with live GitHub-flavored preview (Mermaid, tables, links, images, front matter, sync scroll), image editor (zoom, grid, chessboard), SVG preview, Edit as Table for CSV/TSV
- [Editor](guide/user/editor.md): editing, completion, postfix completion, Complete Current Statement (Ctrl+Shift+Enter), Cyclic Expand Word (Alt+/), Quick Documentation (Ctrl+Q), Quick Definition, Go to Declaration, Find/Show Usages, Rename (Shift+F6), Show Context Actions (Alt+Enter), inspections, folding, multiple carets
- [Emmet and color previews](guide/user/emmet-and-colors.md): Emmet abbreviations + Tab in HTML/Blade/Twig/Vue/PHP/JSX/CSS (`ul>li*3`, `m10`, `df`), abbreviation preview, Surround with Emmet, Update/Remove Tag, edit points (Alt+Shift+] / Alt+Shift+[), gutter color swatches and the color picker
- [Sticky lines, breadcrumbs and Reader mode](guide/user/code-structure.md): Sticky Lines while scrolling, structure breadcrumbs (bottom/top, siblings), custom folding regions (`// region`, `#region`, `<!-- region -->`, `<editor-fold>`), rendered PHPDoc/JSDoc/LuaDoc comments (Ctrl+Alt+Q) and Reader mode for library files
- [JSON Schema](guide/user/json-schema.md): validation (PHPStorm's messages), completion, hover and Go to Declaration from JSON schemas in JSON, JSON5 and YAML files; built-in schemas for composer.json, package.json, tsconfig, ESLint, Prettier, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI; `$schema`, JSON Schema Mappings, status bar widget, remote schemas and the SchemaStore catalog
- [Spelling and grammar](guide/user/spelling-and-grammar.md): Typo (green) and Grammar (blue) inspections in comments, strings, declared names, Markdown and commit messages, Alt+Enter Typo: Change to / Rename to, Save to project-level or application-level dictionary, custom Hunspell dictionaries, Settings | Editor | Natural Languages
- [Optimize Imports and Auto Import](guide/user/imports.md): Optimize Imports (Ctrl+Alt+O) for files, folders and the project ("Only VCS changed files"), Settings | Editor | General | Auto Import for PHP and JavaScript/TypeScript (on the fly, import popup, completion, FQN), Import class with the Class to Import chooser, PHP code style Imports tab (sorting, grouping, blank lines)
- [Actions on Save](guide/user/actions-on-save.md): Settings | Tools | Actions on Save: Reformat code (whole file or changed lines), Optimize imports, Rearrange code, code cleanup, eslint --fix, Prettier, Rector, PHP CS Fixer, phpcbf and Laravel Pint on Ctrl+S or autosave, one undo step
- [Database tools and SQL console](guide/user/database.md): data sources for MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite, SQL Server (tiberius), ClickHouse (HTTP), Oracle (SQL*Plus / SQLcl installed by the user), Redis (keys tree, value viewer) and MongoDB (documents as JSON, shell-style console); SSH tunnels and SSL/TLS per data source, query consoles with own or shared sessions, the Sessions view, read-only and production (red) data sources with the UPDATE/DELETE-without-WHERE confirmation, data grid editing and export
- [Language injections](guide/user/language-injections.md): SQL/HTML/CSS/JSON/RegExp in PHP and JS strings, `// language=` comments, heredoc labels, Inject language or reference, Un-inject, Edit Fragment, Run SQL (Ctrl+Enter)
- [Live templates](guide/user/live-templates.md): abbreviation + Tab, Insert Live Template (Ctrl+J), Surround With (Ctrl+Alt+T), Unwrap/Remove (Ctrl+Shift+Delete), Save as Live Template, PHP/JS/Lua/Twig/Laravel/Blade/Symfony sets
- [File and code templates](guide/user/file-templates.md): New ▸ PHP Class/Interface/Trait/Enum with PSR-4 namespaces, framework, web and Lua file templates, the Alt+Insert New popup, Settings | Editor | File and Code Templates (Velocity syntax, variables, code templates of the Generate actions)
- [Vim emulation](guide/user/vim-emulation.md): IdeaVim-style Vim emulation (Tools | Vim, Ctrl+Alt+V): Normal/Insert/Visual/Replace and command-line modes, motions, operators, text objects, registers incl. the clipboard, dot repeat, macros, marks, search, :s/:g/:normal and other ex commands, :set options, ~/.ideavimrc (set, map/noremap, let mapleader, :action and <Action>() mappings, sethandler), Settings | Editor | Vim shortcut conflicts
- [Search Everywhere and navigation](guide/user/search-everywhere.md): Search Everywhere, Go to Class/File/Symbol, Find in Files
- [Inspections](guide/user/inspections.md): inspection profiles (Default, Project Default, PHPStorm XML import/export) with severities, scope-specific settings and options applied to every problem, Inspect Code and Inspection Results, Run Inspection by Name (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+I), Code Cleanup with preview, @noinspection / noinspection suppressions, duplicated code, PHP data flow, `forge inspect` command-line inspector for CI
- [Scopes and file colors](guide/user/scopes-and-file-colors.md): named scopes in PHPStorm's scope language, predefined scopes, file colors in tabs and the Project view
- [Structural Search and Replace](guide/user/structural-search.md): templates with $variables$, filters, Replace All with preview
- [Type, Method and Call Hierarchy](guide/user/hierarchies.md): the Hierarchy tool window: Type Hierarchy (Ctrl+H; class, supertypes, subtypes), Method Hierarchy (Ctrl+Shift+H) with defined / should define / inherited marks, Call Hierarchy (Ctrl+Alt+H; callers and callees with call sites), scopes, sorting, language servers and the PHP index
- [Go to Test and Create Test](guide/user/go-to-test.md): Navigate | Test (Ctrl+Shift+T) between classes/modules and tests, Create New PHP Test / Create New Test dialog (PHPUnit, Pest, Vitest, Jest; PSR-4 autoload-dev, Laravel Unit/Feature, Symfony tests/)
- [File Structure, Navigation Bar and Related Symbol](guide/user/navigation-bar-and-file-structure.md): File Structure popup (Ctrl+F12, Show Inherited), Navigation Bar (Alt+Home; Top, In Status Bar, Don't Show), Related Symbol (Ctrl+Alt+Home: tests, Laravel views/routes/migrations, Twig templates, component tests/stories/styles)
- [Shortcuts by topic](guide/user/shortcuts/index.md): every implemented shortcut explained by area, with screenshots
- [Keymap reference card](guide/user/shortcuts/reference-card.md): the 62 most important shortcuts on one page
- [PHP](guide/user/php.md): the PHP index, navigation (Ctrl+Click, usages, implementations, PHP stubs), Rename with the index fallback, Extract / Introduce (variable, constant, field, parameter, method) and Inline, PHP intentions, Structure tool window, hover docs, Generate (Alt+Insert), `.phpstorm.meta.php` metadata, JetBrains attributes (#[Deprecated], #[ExpectedValues], #[ArrayShape], #[Immutable], #[Pure], #[NoReturn], #[Language]), source roots (Settings | Directories, Mark Directory as, PSR-4 namespace inspection) and include paths (External Libraries)
- [PHP Quality Tools](guide/user/php-quality-tools.md): Settings | PHP | Quality Tools: PHPStan, Psalm, PHP CS Fixer, PHP_CodeSniffer (phpcs/phpcbf), PHP Mess Detector, Laravel Pint and Rector with an On/Off inspection, executable, PHP interpreter (Docker, Compose, SSH, WSL with path mappings), configuration file, level/ruleset, options, timeout and severity; problems on the fly and on save in the editor and Problems tool window; Reformat with …, Fix with … quick fixes, Rector's diff preview, Actions on Save, Inspect Code with Quality Tools; refused in Safe Mode
- [Composer](guide/user/composer.md): the composer.json toolbar (Install, Update, Validate, Show Outdated, Audit), outdated packages with the Update package quick fix, package and version completion from Packagist (cached, offline fallback), package hover, Manage Composer Dependencies (Tools | Composer | Add Dependency…), `composer audit` in the Problems tool window, composer.phar download with SHA-256 check
- [Laravel](guide/user/laravel.md): Blade, routes, views, config, Eloquent, ide.json completions and code generations, the Routes tool window, the Laravel tool window (overview, logs) and artisan commands
- [Symfony](guide/user/symfony.md) and [Doctrine](guide/user/doctrine.md): framework and ORM support (Symfony: services, routes, Twig, translations with folding and the missing-key inspection, form options, events and listeners)
- [WordPress](guide/user/wordpress.md): hook completion, Go to Declaration between add_action and do_action, gutter icons, Find Usages of hooks, the WordPress tool window, Tools | WP-CLI…, stubs from vendor/ (installed with consent), the WordPress code style with the Yoda condition hint, plugin and theme file templates
- [Drupal, Joomla and Shopware](guide/user/cms.md): CMS detection, Drupal .module/.install/.theme/.inc as PHP, Drupal hook completion with Go to the hook docs, Shopware sw_* Twig tags, Smarty, Joomla manifests, Tools | Drush… and Shopware Console…
- [WebForge](guide/user/webforge.md): HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, Vue, React, Angular
- [JavaScript debugging and testing](guide/user/javascript-debugging.md): js-debug (downloaded on consent, SHA-256 pinned) for Node.js, npm scripts, tests and Chrome/Edge, TypeScript breakpoints through source maps, attach by port or process; Jest, Vitest, Mocha, Playwright, Cypress and node --test with gutter icons, test tree, Rerun Failed Tests and coverage
- [RustForge (Rust)](guide/user/rust.md): rustup toolchains (active toolchain, rust-toolchain.toml, install with consent), sysroot and std sources; the Cargo tool window (members, targets, feature checkboxes, dependency tree; Reload, Run, Debug, Build, Check, Clean, Update); Cargo and Cargo Test configurations (libtest JSON on nightly, plain output on stable, cargo-nextest, doctests, Rerun Failed, coverage with cargo-llvm-cov); Clippy problems with quick fixes; rustfmt; rust-analyzer settings and download; LLDB / GDB debugging with rustc's pretty printers
- [GoForge (Go)](guide/user/go.md): Go SDK (GOROOT detection, verified downloads from go.dev/dl) and GOPATH, GOFLAGS, build tags; go.mod / go.work checks and completion (module proxy, cached); gofmt / goimports; go vet and golangci-lint problems; go generate; Go Build and Go Test (subtests, benchmarks, fuzzing, coverage, profiles); Delve debugging (launch, test, attach, remote dlv --headless); the pprof Profiler (flame graph, call tree, method list)
- [Django, Flask, FastAPI and Celery](guide/user/python-web-frameworks.md): the Endpoints tool window (Django URL patterns, Flask routes and blueprints, FastAPI endpoints with APIRouter prefixes, Open in HTTP Client, /docs), Django settings detection, Django Structure, Run manage.py Task (Ctrl+Alt+R), Django templates with Ctrl+B / completion for render, {% extends %}, {% include %} and {% url %}, the unresolved template inspection, and the Django Server, Django tests, Flask Server, FastAPI (uvicorn) and Celery worker / beat run configurations
- [PyForge (Python)](guide/user/python.md): Python interpreters (venv, uv, Poetry, conda, Pipenv, Hatch, Docker, SSH, WSL) in the status bar and Settings | Project | Python Interpreter, the Python Packages tool window (pip/uv/Poetry/Pipenv, PyPI), requirements inspections with Install/Add requirement, basedpyright, ty and ruff with verified downloads, ruff format / Black, the Python run configuration, pytest / unittest / tox in the test runner, debugpy with the debug console, the Python Console (IPython, variables, Alt+Shift+E) and the cProfile profiler (call tree, hot spots)
- [Jupyter notebooks](guide/user/jupyter.md): the notebook editor (code, Markdown and raw cells, command and edit mode with Shift+Enter, A, B, D D, M, Y), outputs (ANSI text, images, sanitized HTML in a sandboxed frame, errors, JSON), DataFrame tables with sorting, filter and pages, kernels (ipykernel in the project's interpreter over ZeroMQ, or a Jupyter server with its token in the keychain), the Variables view with View as DataFrame, and notebook diffs cell by cell
- [JavaForge](guide/user/java.md): Java with Eclipse JDT LS (installed with consent from download.eclipse.org), JDKs (detection, Eclipse Temurin downloads, project JDK, language level), Maven and Gradle (Gradle / Maven tool windows with tasks, resolved dependency trees, sync, offline mode, profiles and Skip Tests, the Gradle wrapper with distributionSha256Sum and Update Wrapper, Build Project Ctrl+F9, build and run through Gradle or JDT LS, Kotlin / Groovy DSL and pom.xml completion with Maven Central coordinates and newer-version quick fix), Application / Gradle / Maven / JUnit / TestNG / Remote JVM Debug run configurations, JUnit 5/4 and TestNG through the build tool with JaCoCo coverage, the Java debugger (java-debug, hot code replace)
- [CForge (C and C++)](guide/user/cpp.md): C and C++ in the style of CLion: clangd with clang-tidy (PATH, toolchain or a download from the clangd GitHub releases with SHA-256 check), toolchains (GCC, Clang, MSVC through vswhere, MinGW, cross compilers; versions parsed in Rust), CMake profiles and CMakePresets.json / CMakeUserPresets.json, the CMake tool window (cmake-file-api targets, configure log linked to CMakeLists.txt), compilation database projects, Build / Rebuild / Clean (Ctrl+F9) with GCC / Clang / MSVC / linker problems, CMake Application run configurations, GoogleTest / Catch2 / CTest with gutter icons, Rerun Failed and gcov / llvm-cov coverage, LLDB / GDB debugging with STL pretty printers
- [C/C++ dynamic analysis and packages](guide/user/cpp-tools.md): sanitizers (ASan, UBSan, TSan, MSan, LSan) as CMake profile options with `-fsanitize` flags, sanitizer reports of runs and tests parsed in Rust into the Run tool window's Sanitizers tab (stacks, code preview, editor highlights), Run with Valgrind Memcheck (`--xml=yes`, errors, leak summary), Profile with perf (`perf record -g`, `perf script` as a flame graph in the shared Profiler; Linux only), vcpkg manifest mode (toolchain file, port completion) and Conan 2 (Conan Install, `conan_toolchain.cmake`)
- [Embedded development](guide/user/embedded.md): PlatformIO (`platformio.ini` envs, the PlatformIO tool window with build / upload / monitor / test / clean / compiledb tasks), ESP-IDF (`idf.py` build, flash, monitor, menuconfig), Zephyr (`west build` / flash / debug with board selection), OpenOCD Download & Run and Embedded GDB Server configurations (flash, GDB `target remote` through the shared DAP layer) and the CMSIS-SVD Peripherals view
- [Spring Boot and Jakarta EE](guide/user/spring.md): JavaForge's Spring support from static analysis of Java and Kotlin sources: beans (stereotypes, @Bean, Spring Data repositories, @ConfigurationProperties, CDI and EJB beans) with injection point gutter navigation, the Endpoints tool window (Spring MVC / WebFlux mappings with class prefixes, JAX-RS resources) with Open in HTTP Client, JPA entities (Persistence tab), application.properties / application.yml key and value completion, hover docs, unknown/deprecated key and invalid value inspections and Ctrl+B to @ConfigurationProperties from spring-configuration-metadata.json of the synced dependency jars or the local Maven/Gradle caches, the Spring Boot run configuration (profiles, override properties) and the run dashboard in Services with actuator health, mappings and beans
- [Groovy and Scala](guide/user/groovy-scala.md): JavaForge's JVM extras - Groovy highlighting, Groovy Script runs with groovy (Groovy SDK, SDKMAN!) or through Gradle (init script), Groovy source sets in the Gradle tool window, Spock through Gradle or Maven; Scala with sbt (the sbt tool window from build.sbt and an sbt import, sbt Task configurations and the sbt shell, runMain gutter), ScalaTest and MUnit through sbt testOnly with JUnit XML, Metals installed with the user's Coursier on request (pinned)
- [Android](guide/user/android.md): Gradle Android projects (AGP modules, manifests), the Android SDK location (setting, ANDROID_HOME, local.properties; never downloaded), the Device Manager (adb devices, emulator AVDs), Android App run configurations (assemble, adb install, am start) and Logcat with Android Studio's query language (package:mine, level:, tag:, is:crash), colors per level and clickable stack traces
- [KotlinForge](guide/user/kotlin.md): Kotlin/JVM with JetBrains' kotlin-lsp (downloaded with consent from download.jetbrains.com, pinned SHA-256; or kotlin-language-server), Kotlin runs through Gradle (init script), Maven or kotlinc with a Run gutter on main, Kotlin scripts (.kts), JUnit 5 and Kotest (FunSpec, StringSpec, DescribeSpec, BehaviorSpec) through the build, the Kotlin debugger (kotlin-lsp) with a Coroutines tab, ktlint and detekt in the Problems view, ktlint format
- [Command Line Tool Support](guide/user/command-line-tools.md): Tools | Run Command… (Ctrl+Shift+X): Composer, Laravel Artisan, Symfony Console, WP-CLI, Drush and custom tools as `alias command args` with completion of commands, options and arguments, command help, history, the Command Line Tools Console tool window, command lists cached until composer.lock changes, Settings | Tools | Command Line Tool Support
- [Testing](guide/user/testing.md): the shared test runner of every pack (PHP, busted, manifest frameworks), gutter run icons, test tree, Click to see difference, Rerun Failed Tests, Test History, auto-test, result formats (TeamCity, JUnit, TAP, Go test2json, libtest JSON and plain text, pytest, Jest/Vitest JSON)
- [Code coverage](guide/user/coverage.md): Run with Coverage, the Coverage tool window (line and branch coverage), editor gutter marks with hits, Project view coverage, Show Coverage Data, LCOV/Cobertura/Clover/JaCoCo/Go reports
- [Run targets](guide/user/run-targets.md): Run on a Docker image, Docker Compose service, SSH host, WSL or Dev Container for runs, tests, coverage and debugging, with path mappings and debugger ports
- [PHP test frameworks](guide/user/test-frameworks.md): Settings | PHP | Test Frameworks, PHPUnit, Pest, Codeception, Behat and PHPSpec run configurations, gutter icons, test tree, Rerun Failed Tests, Test History, auto-test, Gherkin highlighting and Behat step definitions
- [Deployment](guide/user/deployment.md): Tools | Deployment: SFTP (SSH configurations), FTP/FTPS and local-folder servers, root path, web server URL, path mappings, excluded paths, default server, Upload to… (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+X), Download, Compare with Deployed Version, Sync with Deployed, Delete on server, upload on save (Always / On explicit save action / Never), Deployment | Options, the File Transfer tool window, passwords in the keychain, Safe Mode
- [Remote development](guide/user/remote-development.md): open a project on a Linux host over SSH (JetBrains Gateway style): connections, host keys, jump hosts, the Forge agent, what runs on the host, reconnects, SSH Configurations
- [Dev Containers and WSL](guide/user/dev-containers-and-wsl.md): devcontainer.json (image, Dockerfile, Docker Compose, lifecycle commands, mounts, ports, features listed), Create Dev Container and Mount Sources with the build log, Start / Stop / Rebuild / Delete, the agent over docker exec; WSL distributions, `\\wsl$` paths, Windows ↔ Linux path mapping, Terminal › WSL
- [Remote Host and SSH sessions](guide/user/remote-host-and-ssh.md): the Remote Host tool window (Tools | Deployment | Browse Remote Host: lazy server tree, mapped folders, Edit Remote File with a conflict check, Download from Here, Upload to Here, Compare with Local Version, New, Rename, Delete, Copy Path), Settings | Tools | SSH Configurations (parse ~/.ssh/config), Tools | Start SSH Session… in the Terminal, Safe Mode
- [Project trust and Safe Mode](guide/user/project-trust.md): "Trust and Open Project?" (Trust Project, Preview in Safe Mode, Don't Open), what Safe Mode refuses, the Safe Mode banner, Trusted Locations, remote projects
- [Run and debug](guide/user/run-debug.md) and [Debugging](guide/user/debugging.md): run configurations (PHP Built-in Web Server, PHP Web Page, PHP HTTP Request, Native Application, Compound), Before launch tasks, Run Anything (double Ctrl), External Tools and macros, Xdebug, debug adapters (LLDB, GDB, Attach to Process, Attach to DAP server, core dumps), breakpoints, logpoints and watchpoints, threads, memory, disassembly and registers, debugger console, Web Server Debug Validation
- [Git](guide/user/git.md) and [Code hosts](guide/user/code-hosts.md): clone (Get from VCS), commit, message history, signing, branches, worktrees, log, blame, pull requests
- [Local History](guide/user/local-history.md): revisions recorded on save, refactorings, VCS operations and external changes; Show History, Show History for Selection, Revert, Create Patch, labels, Recent Changes
- [AI](guide/user/ai.md): AI providers, agent chat and AI commit messages
- [Language servers](guide/user/language-servers.md): installing and configuring external language servers
- [Settings and themes](guide/user/settings-and-themes.md): the Settings dialog, Settings for New Projects, Restore Defaults, Export / Import Settings, Restore Default Settings, Ember and Anvil themes
- [Color schemes](guide/user/color-schemes.md): Settings | Editor | Color Scheme, Ember and Anvil, user schemes, per-attribute editing with live preview, IntelliJ .icls import and export
- [Invalidate Caches and Repair IDE](guide/user/repair-ide.md): Reload All from Disk, the step-by-step Repair IDE, Invalidate Caches and which caches it clears
